title: Pocketwire Business Profile Payout Rules
content:
The business balance of a Pocketwire Business Profile takes in sales and gives out fees, refunds, chargebacks and payouts. Funds under a hold remain part of it but are not available for payout. A payout moves money to a linked bank account (a standard bank payout), to a debit card (an instant card payout) or to the owner's Pocketwire Personal Account balance.

## Rules in force

1. A payout can be made only while the profile status is active; payouts pause while the profile is under review or suspended. The status is read from the profile record.
2. A payout must be at least the tier's smallest payout amount.
3. An instant card payout may not exceed the tier's maximum amount of one instant payout.
4. A standard bank payout is free and arrives within the tier's standard payout time in business days; a payout to the owner's personal balance is free and immediate.
5. An instant card payout books an instant payout fee of the payout amount multiplied by the tier's instant payout fee percentage, rounded to the cent (half up), raised to the tier's minimum fee and lowered to the tier's maximum fee. When an instant payout is returned, its fee is credited back in full, and the returned amount is credited back to the business balance.
6. Where the tier offers it, the owner can switch on a daily automatic standard bank payout of the whole available balance, booked like any other payout.
7. A payout that breaches a limit is declined in full and not booked.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses are **no longer in force**. They are superseded by the current basis on which the instant payout amount and the bank payout amount are worked out:

- "A payout can never exceed the available balance, which is the business balance less the funds under unreleased holds."
- "Together with the day's earlier payouts, a payout may not exceed the daily payout limit."

## Worked fee figures (hypothetical fee terms of 2.00%, minimum USD 0.50, maximum USD 12.00)

| Instant payout | Percentage part | Fee booked |
|---|---|---|
| USD 10.00 | USD 0.20 | USD 0.50 (raised to the minimum) |
| USD 300.00 | USD 6.00 | USD 6.00 |
| USD 1000.00 | USD 20.00 | USD 12.00 (lowered to the maximum) |

superseded_clauses: A payout can never exceed the available balance, which is business_balance less the funds under unreleased holds (business_msr_active_holds)
together with the day's earlier payouts (business_msr_payouts_today) may not exceed daily_payout_limit
